languageData.TentacleSoothe.label: soothing pheromones
languageData.TentacleSoothe.description: This pawn is being affected by soothing phermones, emitted by a nearby Amor Tentculum creature. This increases the pawn's sex drive and psychic sensitivity. It also lowers its receptiveness to pain. All at a small penalty to consciousness.
languageData.IBworm.label: indoctrination worm
languageData.IBworm.description: A parisitic worm, attached to the brain stem. Keeps the victim content and ready to die, even under horrible conditions.
languageData.Bworm.label: breeding worm
languageData.Bworm.description: A parisitic worm, attached to the brain stem. Keeps the victim aroused, energetic, and agressive.
languageData.Fworm.label: feeding worm
languageData.Fworm.description: A tentacle living in the throat and mouth. Rapidly digests food for the host and injects it as a slurry down their throat. Makes the recipient immune to gutworms and food poisoning.
languageData.TentacleCollarNumb.label: numbed
languageData.TentacleCollarNumb.description: The secretions from the Tentacle Collar are numbing the wearer's body, making them more pliant and susceptible to control.
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.label: Brood Mother egg
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.description: An Amor Brood Mother egg is being incubated by the Queen, and is growing inside her body. This process takes around 20 days (with default multipliers), and she will not enjoy it (although her Host body will adapt to suppress the pain over time).
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.0.label: tiny
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.1.label: small
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.2.label: large
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.3.label: huge
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.4.label: enormous
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.5.label: ready to deliver
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.6.label: overdue, painful
languageData.BroodMotherIncubation.stages.7.label: overdue, debilitating
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggLabor.label: Laying Egg (dilating)
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggLabor.description: The Amor Queen is preparing to birth an Amor Brood Mother egg. The labor process does not take a fixed amount of time, and the Host will progress through various stages of pain and contractions. Due to the size of the Egg, this will be quite debilitating.
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggLabor.stages.0.label: mild
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggLabor.stages.1.label: intense
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggLabor.stages.2.label: debilitating
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggDelivery.label: Laying Egg (pushing)
languageData.AmorBroodMotherEggDelivery.description: The Amor Queen is actively birthing an Amor Brood Mother egg and can do nothing but focus on the delivery. The egg is coming!
languageData.OrganElasticity.label: organ elasticity
languageData.OrganElasticity.description: The elasticity of the Host's body is the main factor in determing how many tentacles they can hold. Can be increased by filling the body to the brim with tentacles, at which point the tentacles will further modify the body and stretch it further. Can also be increased with certain implants.\n\nNote that increasing the capacity beyond a certain point will make the host essentially immune to pain, which may not always be a good thing. And there's no going back...
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.0.label: slightly stretchy
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.1.label: a little stretchy
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.2.label: stretchy
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.3.label: very stretchy
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.4.label: elastic
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.5.label: very elastic
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.6.label: voracious tentacle gobbler
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.7.label: bottomless tentacle pit
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.8.label: tentacle black hole
languageData.OrganElasticity.stages.9.label: ludicrous
languageData.AmorQueenPregnancy.label: Amor Queen
languageData.AmorQueenPregnancy.description: The Amor Queen is permanently pregnant. The Host can gestate massive Amor Brood Mother eggs over time, whenever they choose, once they have reached the "fertile" stage. Additionally, as they become accustomed to the permanent pregnancy, their bodies will be adapted to protect the growing eggs.
languageData.AmorQueenPregnancy.stages.0.label: fresh
languageData.AmorQueenPregnancy.stages.1.label: adapting
languageData.AmorQueenPregnancy.stages.2.label: fertile
languageData.AmorQueenPregnancy.stages.3.label: breeder
languageData.TentacleStorage.label: tentacle storage
languageData.TentacleStorage.description: Amor Squirmer tentacles are living inside the Host's body. Over time, they will increase the movement, regeneration, and psychic sensitivity of the Host.
languageData.TentacleStorage.stages.0.label: few
languageData.TentacleStorage.stages.1.label: many
languageData.TentacleStorage.stages.2.label: a lot
languageData.TentacleStorage.stages.3.label: a ton
languageData.TentacleStorage.stages.4.label: a silly amount
languageData.AmorQueenSlimeProduction.label: producing slime
languageData.AmorQueenSlimeProduction.description: The Amor Queen is producing slime from her vagina. And by "producing", we mean "slowly leaking out of". However disgusting that may seem, the tentacle slime that she is producing is an extremely valuable resource. Make sure your pawns collect it!
languageData.TentacleLimbVagina.label: vaginal mobility tentacle
languageData.TentacleLimbVagina.description: A prehensile tentacle, emerging from the Host's vagina, aiding in movement and defense.
languageData.TentacleLimbVagina.stages.0.label: thin

languageData.QueenEggIncubationFailure.description: The Amor Queen egg is rejecting this host body. It will result in a slow and painful death...

languageData.QueenEggOverrideFailure.label: Queen incubation failure
languageData.QueenEggOverrideFailure.description: The attempt to implant an Amor Queen egg failed, as this pawn already is an Amor Host. This will cause them pain for a few days, but they will recover.
languageData.QueenEggOverrideFailure.comps.HediffComp: {0_labelShort} was unable to incubate a second Amor Host egg type. They will be in pain for a while, but will recover.
languageData.BaronEggOverrideFailure.label: Baron incubation failure
languageData.BaronEggOverrideFailure.description: The attempt to implant an Amor Baron egg failed, as this pawn already is an Amor Host. This will cause them pain for a few days, but they will recover.

languageData.QueenEggIncubationSuccess.label: Queen egg incubation
languageData.QueenEggIncubationSuccess.description: An Amor Queen egg is growing within the host. Unlike a normal pregnancy, this will not result in birth, but will gradually transform the host into an Amor Queen. The incubation process takes approximately 15 days (with default multipliers).

languageData.TentacleInfestedAnus.label: stretched rectum
languageData.TentacleInfestedAnus.description: The growing Amor egg has invaded this part of the Host's body. Their rectum and intestines are being stretched to accommodate larger and more plentiful tentacle insertions. These processes are uncomfortable.
